integrationPoints.placement: Inside the handler, before any prompt is assembled. Reads server-side configuration only — an environment variable or a server-held config value. integrationPoints.mustPreserve: Absent or unreadable configuration resolves certified-v140. Configuration reading must never throw out of the handler.

integrationPoints.purpose: resolve the runtime scanner version, once per execution

integrationPoints.mustPreserve: Exactly one resolved identity per request; immutable thereafter; fails closed to certified-v140 on unknown, malformed, or request-shaped input; never throws.

integrationPoints.placement: The narrowest correct seam. `withQualityAndRoute` is ALREADY the single prompt-composition point: it layers QUALITY_TUNE_PROMPT_ADDENDUM and buildRoutedIdentifyPrompt onto a base prompt, and every prompt binding (identifyPrompt, multiItemPrompt, textIdentifyPrompt, selectedItemPrompt) flows through it. A candidate overlay appended as the LAST layer inside this function reaches every prompt path with one change, and the certified text remains first and verbatim.
integrationPoints.mustPreserve: Append only — the certified prompt is never rewritten or reordered. Applied at most ONCE per request. When the resolved version is certified-v140, this layer is a strict no-op and the composed prompt must be byte-identical to today's.

integrationPoints.placement: Where the response object is assembled, and wherever scan telemetry is emitted.
integrationPoints.mustPreserve: Ids, hashes, enums, counts and booleans only. The instruction DIGEST may be emitted; the instruction TEXT may not.

certifiedFallbackPathUnchanged.requirement: MUST REMAIN UNCHANGED. The certified route owns the only fallback: one primary attempt, then one approved fallback model, with permanent failures stopping immediately. Reaching the fallback model is a transport event WITHIN one logical request — it is not a second selected version and must not be recorded as one. The candidate must not add an attempt, a retry, a second dispatch, or a repair pass.
